author: Ryan Daws
description:
Microsoft has added an AI pillar to its Zero Trust Assessment tool and a DevSecOps pillar to its Zero Trust Workshop. Development teams now hand code generation, dependency selection, and infrastructure configuration to AI tools. Each of those tasks carries its own permission set, its own dependency chain, its own way of going wrong when […]

title: Microsoft adds AI and DevSecOps pillars to zero trust tools
